title: Registered
description: Server -> client. Reply to `register`. The connection is authenticated as this device from here on.

deviceId.description: Permanent device handle. A UUID rather than a short code on purpose: it is what a phone sends in `connectRequest`, and short handles would make desktops enumerable.

credential.description: The device secret, in plaintext, appearing here and nowhere else ever. The server stores only a salted hash, so a device that loses this must re-enroll and re-pair. Persist it in the OS keychain (desktop) or IndexedDB (phone).
